entry.content:
We are inviting all registered youth residents of Barangay Libis to attend our upcoming general assembly this coming weekend. We will be discussing new community projects, sports league sign-ups, and open youth concerns.

Date & Time: September 25, 2026 at 9:00 AM
Location: Barangay Libis Covered Court
